lines.text: Find a clock with a second hand. Look away, then look back.
The first second is too long.
It just hangs there. Then it ticks on, perfectly normal.
The clock is fine. You were not there.
Your eyes do not glide. They jump. Three, four times a second.
And while they are moving, the picture is switched off.
You would see a smear otherwise. So your brain cuts it out.
But now there is a hole in the tape.
So it fills the hole backwards, with the first thing you land on.
That is your long second. It is not a long second at all.
It is a blank, painted over with the clock.
Something like a tenth of your waking life happens with the lights off.
And the one time you catch it, you blame the clock.
